about:
Hou-Tex Sheet Metal Inc. operates as a family-owned and operated sheet metal fabrication and installation company in Houston, Texas. The firm does not publicly disclose its founding year or the names of its founders, nor does it provide details about its ownership structure beyond the family-owned designation in available sources.

The company's core business is sheet metal fabrication and installation, with an emphasis on high-quality products and reliable services. According to its public messaging, Hou-Tex applies the highest standards to its fabrication work and focuses on delivering on-time solutions that fit within project budgets. Information about the physical plant, workforce size, annual throughput, or catalog depth is not provided.

The company does not enumerate specific industry verticals or reference individual customers in its published materials. It presents itself as a resource for custom sheet metal projects where quality assurance and schedule adherence are priorities. The stated point of difference is a "Foundation of Quality," which the company ties to rigorous fabrication standards and a commitment to meeting both budget and timeline expectations. The company's website carries the tagline "Built on a Foundation of Quality" and invites prospective customers to inquire about its products and services.
